title: Installing Task Centric Memory related dependency causes protobuf version conflicting error
body:
### What happened?

**Describe the bug**
User may run into following error after running `pip install autogen-ext[task-centric-memory]` to install dependency

```
TypeError: Descriptors cannot be created directly.
E   If this call came from a _pb2.py file, your generated code is out of date and must be regenerated with protoc >= 3.19.0.
E   If you cannot immediately regenerate your protos, some other possible workarounds are:
E    1. Downgrade the protobuf package to 3.20.x or lower.
E    2. Set PROTOCOL_BUFFERS_PYTHON_IMPLEMENTATION=python (but this will use pure-Python parsing and will be much slower).
```

It happens because Task Centric Memory(TCM) feature needs chromadb, chromadb has pulled opentelemetry-proto as dependency and older version of opentelemetry-proto used protobuf 3.x version to generate files which conflicts with the protobuf version in AutoGen(5.29.3).

**To Reproduce**
1. Run `pip install autogen-ext[task-centric-memory]`
2. Run `test_playwright_controller.py` you will see the error message above

**Expected behavior**
Test and TCM feature should run without error



### Which packages was the bug in?

Python Extensions (autogen-ext)

Python 0.5.1

linked_prs.title: Pin opentelemetry-proto version
linked_prs.body:
## Description
This PR pins opentelemetry-proto version to >=1.28.0, which uses protobuf > 5.0, < 6.0 to generate protobuf files.

## Related issue number
Closes #6304

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves a memory-related dependency (Task Centric Memory) and its conflict with protobuf versions, which falls under the "Memory dependency issues" sub-category in the agent issue taxonomy.
